Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center referral — Acme account mapping & field seller alignment

Team / Sara,

Attaching the first pass of the Acme account grid and the Partner Center referral form. We need to get a Partner Center referral in for the Acme strategic renewal (see HS record below) and align field sellers before Microsoft routes to an AE. High-level asks:

- Confirm field seller / AE ownership for each Acme business unit/region in the attached grid.
- Verify contact email for the Acme exec (we need the primary sponsor for the referral).
- Jonas: can you confirm the referral form fields (offer SKU, estimated TCV, preferred go-to-market motion)?
- Laura: please carve out a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize handoff and create the HubSpot opportunity notes.

Attachments: [attachment: acme-account-grid.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: partner-center-referral-form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Vanessa,

Thanks — quick notes from the AE/AM side:

- AE coverage suggestion: Neha Kapoor for North America strategic (she has the current renewal relationship).
- AM for marketing platform BU: assign Marcus Lin (I'll loop him in once we lock the referral).
- There's a potential overlap in EMEA accounts that were routed to our channel last quarter; recommend we mark those as low-touch on the grid to avoid duplicate outreach.

I'll mark up the attached spreadsheet with AE/AM initials and return by EOD.

Karthik

Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral — Acme account mapping & field seller alignment

Vanessa / all,

I've updated the attached grid with the proposed mapping and added a notes column with the rationale. Key items for the referral form:

- Offer SKU: Redwood-Hosted-Inference / Dedicated-Standard
- Estimated TCV: $420k (FY27 pilot + renewal expansion)
- Preferred GTM: co-sell (partner-led qualification; Microsoft AE to assist on enterprise procurement)
- Primary Acme contact (requested): James Porter, Head of Platform (james.porter@acme.com)

I also flagged two accounts in the grid that need a legal pre-check before we route (data residency asks).

Attachments: [attachment: acme-account-grid.xlsx (updated)]

Jonas Weber
Partner Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the materials — I submitted the referral on Partner Center this morning. Referral ID: REF-987654. Link: https://portal.partnercenter.microsoft.com/referrals/REF-987654

MSFT next steps:
- Your referral will be reviewed by the regional co-sell factory within 48 business hours.
- Please confirm the Acme primary sponsor email (James Porter) and attach the signed MOU if you have one.

- Karthik: add Marcus Lin to the grid for AM coverage (owner: karthik_iyer).
